Does Flood Insurance Help Neighborhoods Recover from Flooding?
abstract: This study explores the impact of flood insurance on post-flooding housing prices. Using a shift-share instrumental variable approach that exploits peers’ flood exposure, we find that a $1,000 increase in flood insurance claims per single-family housing unit in the census-tract boosts housing prices by 1.38% after Hurricane Harvey in Houston, roughly $3,197 based on average housing values. While the median homeowner in flooded neighborhoods sees a 1.9% price decline after flooding, households in neighborhoods at the 75th percentile of flood insurance claims experience no such decrease. Moreover, homes that are less likely to be insured benefit from positive spillover effects and disadvantaged neighborhoods experience greater benefits from flood insurance claims. We also find suggestive evidence that well-insured tracts have fewer foreclosed properties and more home renovation. The increase in capitalized housing values represents approximately 50% of the total amount paid out in Harvey-related claims by the National Flood Insurance Program (FEMA).
abstract_zh: 本研究考察了洪水保险对洪灾后房价的影响。我们采用份额—转移（shift-share）工具变量方法，利用同伴的洪水暴露情况进行识别，发现在休斯顿遭遇飓风哈维（Hurricane Harvey）之后，人口普查区内每单户住宅的洪水保险理赔额每增加1000美元，房价便上涨1.38%，以平均房价计算，约合3197美元。虽然洪水淹没社区的中位数房主所看到的房价下跌1.9%，但洪水保险理赔处于第75百分位的社区则未出现此类下跌。此外，投保率较低的住房能够从正向溢出效应中获益，而弱势社区从洪水保险理赔中获得的收益更大。我们还发现有一定迹象表明，投保充分的地区拥有更少的止赎房产，并进行了更多的住房翻修。资本化的住房价值增加，约占国家洪水保险计划（FEMA）为哈维飓风相关理赔所支付总额的50%。

Riding the Waves of Frequent Floods with Regularly Updated Beliefs: Evidence from Flood Insurance
abstract: As natural disasters occur more often, do people adjust their perceptions of hazard risks more frequently? This research centers on floods, a prevalent natural hazard in the U.S., using monthly changes in flood insurance uptake at the county level as indicators for risk perception updates. Our approach integrates monthly data that capture both local nuances and broader perspectives on flood risks. We find that unforeseen changes in major hydro-meteorological and geophysical natural disasters outside one's home state play the most significant role in updating risk perception, followed by recent flood-related major disasters within one's home county. Media coverage of climate change plays a moderate role, while the impact of extreme local precipitation is comparatively minimal. Notably, our study unveils distinct responses among different groups to diverse themes and presentations in climate change media, with notable variations tied to political affiliations, climate belief, flood risk exposure, education, and employment.
abstract_zh: 随着自然灾害发生得越来越频繁，人们是否会更频繁地调整其对灾害风险的认知？本研究以洪水为对象，洪水是美国普遍存在的一种自然灾害，并以县级层面每月的洪水保险参保变化作为风险认知更新的指标。我们的方法整合了每月数据，既能捕捉地方的细微差别，也能反映对洪水风险的更广阔视角。我们发现，本州以外发生的主要水文气象和地球物理自然灾害中出乎意料的变化，在更新风险认知方面作用最为显著，其次是本县近期发生的与洪水相关的重大灾害。气候变化的媒体报道作用适中，而极端地方降水的影响相对较小。值得注意的是，本研究揭示了不同群体对气候变化媒体中不同主题和呈现方式的反应存在明显差异，这些差异与政治立场、气候信念、洪水风险暴露、教育程度和就业状况有关。

title: Difference-in-Differences with Endogenous Externalities: Model and Application to Climate Econometrics
Identifying the Key Atmospheric and Economic Drivers of Global Carbon Monoxide Emission Transfers
abstract: This paper proposes a structural decomposition analysis (SDA) augmented with cross-country atmospheric circulation and uncovers that changes in carbon monoxide (CO) levels are driven by atmospheric flows way more than by any of the traditional SDA components. Applied to a five-region model, our results show, among others, that South Korea has certainly been able to reduce the CO emissions in its own territory by 0.8Tg over 1990–2014 but up to 10.6Tg of CO flowing to its borders came from its upwind neighbor China. That amount was primarily driven by activities satisfying the growth of China's domestic demand, although changes in foreign demand and in the technology effect were not negligible. By quantifying the role of upwind countries in air pollution changes, our methodology allows us to identify more comprehensive global emission abatement policies than the consumer- or producer-focused approaches currently used.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种融入跨国大气环流的结构分解分析（SDA），发现一氧化碳（CO）水平的变化受大气流动的驱动远远超过任何传统SDA组成部分。应用于一个五区域模型，我们的结果表明，除其他外，韩国在1990–2014年间确实将其本国领土内的CO排放减少了0.8 Tg，但流向其边境的CO中，多达10.6 Tg来自其上风方向的邻国中国。这一数量主要由满足中国国内需求增长的活动所驱动，尽管外国需求变化和技术效应也不可忽视。通过量化上风国家在空气污染变化中的作用，我们的方法使我们能够识别比目前采用的以消费者或生产者为中心的方法更为全面的全球减排政策。

title: Social Learning about Climate Risks
abstract: With a social network adjacency matrix constructed from the Facebook Social Connectedness Index (SCI), this paper examines whether social learning facilitates climate risk perception updates to inform climate adaptation. We find that Hurricanes Harvey and Irma‐induced regional flooding increased flood insurance policies nationwide to the extent of each county's social network proximity to the flooded areas, with a corresponding update in climate risk perception. Social learning resulted in an additional 250,000 policies in flooded counties and 81,000 policies in unflooded counties over 3 years. We find evidence of the salience effect but no support for adverse selection or over‐insurance.
abstract_zh: 利用基于脸书（Facebook）社会关联指数（SCI）构建的社交网络邻接矩阵，本文考察社会学习是否有助于气候风险认知的更新，从而为气候适应提供信息。我们发现，飓风哈维（Harvey）和艾尔玛（Irma）引发的区域性洪水，使全美洪水保险保单数量增加，增幅取决于各县与受灾地区在社交网络中的邻近程度，同时气候风险认知也相应更新。在3年内，社会学习在受灾县带来了额外25万份保单，在未受灾县带来了额外8.1万份保单。我们发现了显著性效应（salience effect）的证据，但没有发现支持逆向选择或过度投保的证据。

title: Does Unconventional Energy Extraction Generate More Wastewater? A Lifetime Perspective
abstract: Unconventional energy extraction has been accompanied by a faster increase in aggregate wastewater generation compared with conventional practice. Understanding the extent to which it is due to technologies, energy production, or geological characteristics has implications for reducing the associated environmental risks. We analyze how wastewater generation patterns differ between unconventional wells and conventional wells, accounting for differences in well configurations and local geology. Using the 2008-2016 monthly production data from 50,039 wells, we show that unconventional wells generated more wastewater in the first 12 months of production but less cumulative discharge than conventional wells. Unconventional oil wells had a lower wastewater-to-energy ratio throughout their lifetime than their conventional counterparts, whereas no efficiency gap existed among gas wells. We find both an increasing initial discharge gap and growing efficiency gains between unconventional wells and conventional wells starting production in more recent years, likely due to increased penetration and persistent improvements of unconventional technologies over time. Our findings call for targeted strategies to balance the short-term disposal burden and the long-term efficiency gains of unconventional energy extraction.
abstract_zh: 与常规开采相比，非常规能源开采伴随着总废水产生量更快的增长。厘清这一现象在多大程度上源于技术、能源产量还是地质特征，对于降低相关环境风险具有重要意义。本文在考虑井的构造差异和当地地质条件的基础上，分析了非常规井与常规井的废水产生模式有何不同。利用2008—2016年50,039口井的月度生产数据，我们发现：非常规井在投产的前12个月产生的废水更多，但累计排放量低于常规井。在整个生命周期内，非常规油井的废水与能源产量之比始终低于常规油井，而非常规气井与常规气井之间不存在效率差距。我们还发现，近年来投产的非常规井与常规井之间，初始排放量的差距不断扩大，效率收益也在增长，这很可能是由于非常规技术的渗透率不断提高，且技术持续改进。我们的研究结果表明，需要采取有针对性的策略，以平衡非常规能源开采在短期内的处置负担与长期的效率收益。

Environmental Hazards and Mortgage Credit Risk: Evidence from Texas Pipeline Incidents
abstract: This study examines the effects of pipeline hazards on credit risk using evidence from the 2005–2011 home mortgage loans in Texas. Difference‐in‐difference analyses show a permanently lower origination rate by 1.9% in the pipeline‐present areas compared to the pipeline‐free areas, which was further enlarged by 1.8% whenever pipeline incidents happened. Evidence suggests that the permanent difference in credit access reflects lenders’ concerns about collateral value and borrowers’ repayment ability. The elevated post‐incident risk perceptions indicate lenders’ aversion to environmental liabilities. Lenders’ risk management strategies differed by borrowers’ income and evolved with the tightening of the securitization market.
abstract_zh: 本研究利用2005—2011年得克萨斯州住房抵押贷款数据，考察管道危害对信贷风险的影响。双重差分分析表明，与无管道地区相比，有管道地区的贷款发放率长期低1.9%；每当发生管道事故，这一差距还会进一步扩大1.8%。证据表明，这种长期存在的信贷可得性差异反映了贷款机构对抵押品价值和借款人还款能力的担忧。事故发生后风险认知的上升，表明贷款机构厌恶环境责任。贷款机构的风险管理策略因借款人收入而异，并随证券化市场的收紧而演变。
